build_requirements.envelope: MVP allowed envelope only (amendment §10): operator-driven, local host, single-tenant, operator-trusted input. H-12 hard-blocks external use.
build_requirements.f59: one-shot ticket enforcement active on every dispatch
build_requirements.observer_boundary: the E3 record is written to the observer's own output root and presented to the evaluator together with that recorder identity (m-3 r4 §3.6); an agent-supplied record is non_applicable(observer-mismatch)
build_requirements.tool_dispatch_constant: the operator-ratified fixed 8-name tool-dispatch constant, served by exact-set equality (F55)

capture_requirements: the external counter readings at both points, from the fixture-owned observer
the parked tool_calls row after recovery quiesces

claim_ceiling.not_claimed: the MVP does NOT claim F59 semantic-effect dedup — a fresh ticket or tool_call_id may be a semantic duplicate, and ambient bash can re-run
claim_ceiling.separation: any explicit INFORMED retry runs in a SEPARATE fixture and result under a fresh ticket; it is not part of this record

clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

drive.note: ordinary settled work preceding the crashed call
the call whose effect becomes externally visible before its outcome commits — this is the crashed call

expected_shape.parked_row: the crashed call's tool_calls row parks UNKNOWN_TOOL_OUTCOME and STAYS parked — it may never transition to EXECUTED

fault.cut_definition: The process is killed at the fixed point after the tool's first effect is externally visible to the fixture-owned observer (the counter has been incremented) and before record_tool_outcome commits. The effect_counter_expectation is bound to THIS point: for this fault point both counters are 1.

negative_controls: the parked row transitioning to EXECUTED at any later point => FAIL
counter_after_recovery > counter_before_recovery => FAIL (recovery caused a second effect)
invocations_after_recovery > 0 => FAIL (recovery caused a second invocation)
objective: The crashed call's tool row parks UNKNOWN_TOOL_OUTCOME and STAYS parked, and recovery causes no second invocation and no second effect.

run_setup.counter_semantics: counter_before_recovery is read after the crash and before recovery starts; counter_after_recovery is read after recovery has quiesced; invocations_after_recovery counts fresh invocations of the same tool identity observed after recovery
run_setup.effect: the observed effect is a monotonic counter INCREMENTED EXACTLY ONCE by the tool invocation, held by a fixture-owned external observer OUTSIDE the app and outside the conductor store, so its reading is independent of any claim the system makes about itself
